comment: Source is not published. Read against docs/modules/FroeZe/Manual.md and the README at tag v2.6.13. The four unnamed encoders are identified from the rendered panel: DM and KIT across the top, LAST STEP and PATTERN below them; the four named buttons sit in the boxed transport row. The module's own menu is Model, File, Outputs and "LOOP" button behavior; Model is the plugin-wide theme submenu and gets no line. The README describes a "CV PATTERN" context-menu option, and no such item exists in 2.6.13: what the build actually does is take an absolute pattern voltage on the PREV. jack whenever NEXT is unpatched, which is what the manual's own pattern-change paragraph says.
